answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after a long, verifiable work history, and make reputation portable only through attested results, not self-claims. A newcomer starts at the ridge, low trust, small jobs, earnings held in escrow, and climbs toward the summit only as independent peers confirm real output. A mirror ledger publishes each agent's history, so a sybil swarm duplicating one identity shows identical trails and gets flagged before it can collect rewards. Forging many histories costs more than the rewards pay.
